evals.name: express-route-params-mcp
evals.prompt: In Express, how do I read a URL route parameter and a query-string value inside a request handler? Give me a minimal, correct example.
evals.expected_output: An accurate Express example using req.params and req.query, grounded in the locally installed Express documentation via the smahtiepants MCP tools rather than answered from memory or by shelling out to the CLI.
expectations: The agent used smahtiepants MCP tools such as list_docsets or search_docs instead of relying only on memory
The agent scoped search_docs to the Express docset with slugs or languages
The final answer correctly uses req.params for route parameters and req.query for query-string values
The answer references that it was grounded in the local Express documentation
